articles.title: Alien 'Biddy Blas' Dominates Talks About 'Star Wars: Galactic Racer' With Two Words: 'Scrib Doon'
articles.description: Biddy Blas is an alien character in the video game Star Wars: Galactic Racer, known for the catchphrase, "Scrib doon." Biddy Blas is a member of the Crocin race of aliens and affiliated with the Galactic League. Biddy Blas and a scene where he intimidates the player by telling them who he is, saying in his Crocin language, "Here's a name for you, amateur! Biddy Blas. Write it down. Tattoo it on your arm, and someday your arm will be worth millions!" When he says "Write it down," he speaks, "Scrib doon." Following the release of Galactic Racer on October 6th, 2026, the scene of Biddy Blas saying "Scrib doon" became the subject of memes and discourse about the high quality of the voice acting. Biddy Blas is often considered a Glup Shitto character.
